item.title: [No Priors] Coinbase’s Everything Exchange: Agentic Finance, Stablecoins, and Tokenization with CEO Brian Armstrong
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:19 The minimum fee typically on a debit or credit card transaction is about 30¢ fee flat plus the additional percentage. Arguably, it doesn't really work well for anything under a dollar. Certainly, it doesn't make sense to pay 30¢ to send a 1¢ payment. And I believe the stats we last saw on this are that about, like, 76% of the agent ecommerce transactions we're seeing are under 30¢. We don't want the AIs to be unbanked.
